title: download progress bar updates immediately on first run
description: On a fresh install, the setup screen shows "0 / 637 MB" and stays there for ~20 seconds on a slow link before the bar jumps to ~400 MB. Cause: `ModelDownloader.download()` only emits `DownloadEvent.Progress` when the network read hits the 256 KiB threshold inside `downloadOne` and `downloadArchive`. The first 256 KiB of any bundle can take seconds on a slow link, during which the UI thinks the download is stalled. Fix: emit an immediate `Progress(0, total, currentFile = bundle.id)` event right when the downloader starts fetching a bundle, plus a Progress event every time `downloadOne` enters a new file (before the first 256 KiB tick) so the file name updates within the first network RTT.
steps: Edit `app/src/main/java/com/convoscribe/models/ModelDownloader.kt`: in `download(bundles)`, before each `downloadArchive(...)` call, `emit(DownloadEvent.Progress(bytesDone = bytesDone, bytesTotal = bytesTotal, currentFile = bundle.id))` so the UI shows the bundle name immediately. After the archive loop is done, the existing outer `Progress(...)` call already covers the post-archive transition; no change needed there.

Same edit for the `downloadOne` loop: before the file-by-file iteration, `emit(DownloadEvent.Progress(bytesDone = bytesDone, bytesTotal = bytesTotal, currentFile = bundle.id))` and inside the loop, before the per-file `downloadOne(...)` call, `emit(DownloadEvent.Progress(bytesDone = bytesDone, bytesTotal = bytesTotal, currentFile = file.fileName))`. That first per-file event is what flips the UI's `currentFile` text from the bundle id to the actual file name within one network RTT.

Add a constant `INITIAL_TICK_FILE_NAME: String = "starting"` (or a similar marker) when emitting the very first 0-byte event, so the UI shows "starting download…" while the connection is still being set up. Read the marker off the receiver's `currentFile` and surface it as a localised "Starting the download…" label when present.

`app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml`: add `setup_progress_starting` ("Starting the download…") — the setup screen already calls `getString(R.string.setup_progress, doneBytes / 1_000_000, totalBytes / 1_000_000)`. Extend `ModelSetupScreen.kt` so when `state.running && state.doneBytes == 0L`, the supporting text reads the "starting" label instead. Implementation: pass an extra `currentFile: String?` field through `SetupUiState` (ViewModel holds the latest `DownloadEvent.Progress.currentFile` alongside `doneBytes`) and the screen uses one of three labels: `setup_progress_starting` when `doneBytes == 0L`, `setup_progress` once there is progress, and the existing default otherwise.

* `app/src/test/java/com/convoscribe/models/ModelDownloaderTest.kt`: add `download_emitsImmediateProgressBeforeFirstTick` — wrap the existing `ModelDownloader` tests with an `OkHttp MockWebServer` that responds with `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and the first chunk taking longer than 256 KiB. Collect events with `flow.toList()`; assert the first emitted event is `Progress(bytesDone = 0, bytesTotal = N, currentFile = "starting")` (or, depending on the marker choice, `currentFile = bundle.id`) emitted BEFORE the first time the body has emitted 256 KiB.

* Add `download_emitsPerFileProgressOnFirstChunk` — same setup with two files in one bundle; assert the events include `Progress(currentFile = file1)` within the first chunk and `Progress(currentFile = file2)` after the first file is done.

* Add `download_archiveEmitsBundleIdImmediately` — a single bundle with `archive != null`; assert the very first event from `download(...)` is `Progress(currentFile = <bundleId or "starting">)` before any bytes are read.
acceptanceCriteria: First emission from `downloader.download(bundles)` is `Progress(bytesDone = 0, bytesTotal = sum(bundle.downloadBytes))` plus a non-empty `currentFile` (either the literal `"starting"` or the bundle id)
Each per-file Progress event for plain (non-archive) bundles has `currentFile` equal to the file name being downloaded, and is emitted before the 256 KiB threshold is reached
Each per-archive Progress event for archive bundles has `currentFile` equal to the bundle id (or `"starting"`) and is emitted before the first archive byte is read
`ModelSetupScreen` shows `setup_progress_starting` while `doneBytes == 0L && running == true`, the numeric "N / N MB" line once progress > 0, and keeps the existing behaviour otherwise
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
notes: Files to read first: `models/ModelDownloader.kt`, `models/ModelCatalog.kt`, `ui/setup/ModelSetupViewModel.kt`, `ui/setup/ModelSetupScreen.kt`, the existing `models/ModelDownloaderTest.kt`. Do not change OkHttp timeouts or the chunk size — 64 KiB buffer / 256 KiB tick stays. Only the *initial* events are added; the steady-state path is untouched. The `currentFile = "starting"` marker is the cleanest way to communicate "no bytes yet" without changing the sealed-interface shape; the screen renders it as a localised label. Never instantiate `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx` engine classes in tests. Always: run `source scripts/env.sh` before Gradle; the verify command is `source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`; run `./gradlew --stop` before ending.
